controller.title: Who handles your data?
controller.body: [Name and contact details of the data controller — to be filled in by the operator.]

data.title: What data do we handle?
data.body: Your email address, display name, optional profile picture, the reminders, expenses, budgets and savings goals you add, your notification settings and your devices' notification endpoints. Short-lived technical logs may also be created to diagnose errors.

purpose.title: What do we use it for?
purpose.body: To run your account, send reminders and notifications, and calculate statistics, budgets and saving tips.

never.title: What we don't do
never.body: We don't ask for banking credentials and can't access your bank account. We don't sell your data and we don't use advertising trackers.

processors.title: Who processes the data?
processors.body: Supabase provides the database, authentication and file storage; Vercel serves the website. Browser notifications are delivered through your browser vendor's push service (e.g. Google, Mozilla, Apple, Microsoft).

retention.title: How long do we keep it?
retention.body: Until you delete your account. Deleting your account also deletes all your data and your profile picture.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request a download of your data and the deletion of your account; both will be available on the Profile page. You can complain to your national data protection authority.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We only use cookies that are needed to work: your sign-in session, the "stay signed in" flag, and your language and theme settings. There are no tracking or advertising cookies.

service.title: The service
service.body: Bank Reminder provides bill and subscription reminders, expense tracking and saving tips. It isn't a bank, doesn't pay for you and can't access your bank account.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You manage your account. Don't share your password, and don't write passwords or account numbers in a reminder's notes field.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.body: Don't disrupt the service, overload the system or access other people's data without permission.

delivery.title: Notifications
delivery.body: We send notifications with great care, but can't guarantee delivery (because of browsers, devices and networks). For important deadlines, don't rely on notifications alone.

tips.title: Tips and news
tips.body: Tips are general estimates based on the data you enter and aren't financial advice. News comes from outside publishers, with source and date; always check an offer's terms in store.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may change these terms; we'll tell you about significant changes in the app.
